archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Halloween: The Game PS5 Release Canceled in Japan

entries.headline: Halloween: The Game PS5 Release Canceled in Japan After Failing to Secure a CERO Rating
entries.summary: IllFonic announced that the Japanese PS5 release of Halloween: The Game has been canceled because the game could not obtain a CERO rating. The PC versions on Steam and Epic Games Store and the Xbox Series X|S version are still planned to launch in Japan on September 9.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report directly embeds IllFonic's official statement. Because the primary statement was not opened separately, the Canonical status remains a media relay of an official announcement.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 2026-08-31T01:20:44Z, or 09:20 Beijing time on August 31, inside the one-time Daily bridge window of August 30 17:00 exclusive through August 31 10:10 inclusive.
entries.releaseTypeLabel: PS5 release cancellation / other platforms proceeding as planned

entries.headline: Crescent Tower: RISING Announced for PC via Steam
entries.summary: AMATA Games and Curry Croquette announced Crescent Tower: RISING, a sequel to Crescent Tower. The game is an 8-bit-style turn-based RPG for PC via Steam and will support multiple languages including Simplified Chinese. A release date has not yet been announced.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report supports the publisher, developer, platform, sequel positioning, language support, and unannounced release date. The Canonical status remains a media relay rather than an official primary-source classification.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published the report at 2026-08-31T01:30:11Z, or 09:30 Beijing time on August 31, inside the one-time Daily bridge window.

entries.headline: Fate/EXTRA Record Moves to Aniplex as Publisher
entries.summary: TYPE-MOON and TYPE-MOON studio BB announced that the remake Fate/EXTRA Record will be published by Aniplex. The project's overall development structure and the organization of studio BB have also been adjusted.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report relays the publisher change and development-structure adjustments from TYPE-MOON and TYPE-MOON studio BB. Because the primary announcement was not opened separately, the Canonical status remains a media relay of an official announcement.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published the report at 2026-08-31T02:05:20Z, or 10:05 Beijing time on August 31, inside the one-time Daily bridge window and before the 10:10 cutoff.

entries.headline: Pokémon UNITE Confirms Four New Pokémon as Zeta Division Wins the Final World Championship
entries.summary: VGC reported that The Pokémon Company announced Morpeko, Toxtricity, Jolteon, and Flareon for Pokémon UNITE after the 2026 Pokémon World Championships final. The first two are planned for September and the latter two for October. Zeta Division won the championship 3–1.
entries.verification: This historical coverage audit uses the opened VGC report retained in the original packet. Its publication time and facts remain bounded to that packet, and the revision does not change the fixed window.
entries.timeNote: VGC published the report at 2026-08-30 18:13 UTC, or 02:13 Beijing time on August 31, inside the fixed bridge window.

entries.headline: Roughly 12–13TB of Historical Steam Builds and Unreleased Test Content Reportedly Leaks Online
entries.summary: VGC relayed claims from Valve community trackers that a collection of Steam games, test builds, and prototypes from 2003 to 2013 had been circulated online, totaling roughly 12–13TB. The report also said the data may have come from a publicly accessible directory rather than a hack. Valve had not officially confirmed the incident in the packet evidence.
entries.verification: This historical coverage audit records only what the opened VGC report described as reported. Community claims are not upgraded to an official Valve conclusion.
entries.timeNote: VGC published the report at 2026-08-30 12:26 UTC, or 20:26 Beijing time on August 30, inside the fixed bridge window.
